mapper.select: select mentor_id from gw_user_profile where user_id=#{userId}

select u.user_id,u.user_name,u.nick_name,p.identity_no,p.user_type,p.mentor_id,m.nick_name mentor_name from sys_user u left join gw_user_profile p on p.user_id=u.user_id left join sys_user m on m.user_id=p.mentor_id where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.del_flag='0'
select user_id from gw_user_profile where identity_no=#{identityNo} limit 1

select p.user_id,u.user_name,u.nick_name,p.identity_no,p.user_type,p.mentor_id,m.nick_name mentor_name from gw_user_profile p left join sys_user u on u.user_id=p.user_id left join sys_user m on m.user_id=p.mentor_id and p.user_id=#{userId}and p.identity_no like concat('%',#{identityNo},'%')and lower(p.user_type)=lower(#{userType}) order by p.user_id

select distinct u.user_id,u.user_name,u.nick_name,p.identity_no,p.user_type,p.mentor_id,m.nick_name mentor_name from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id left join gw_user_profile p on p.user_id=u.user_id left join sys_user m on m.user_id=p.mentor_id where r.role_key=#{roleKey} and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0' and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' order by u.nick_name,u.user_name

select p.user_id,u.user_name,u.nick_name,p.identity_no,p.user_type,p.mentor_id,m.nick_name mentor_name from gw_user_profile p inner join sys_user u on u.user_id=p.user_id left join sys_user m on m.user_id=p.mentor_id where p.mentor_id=#{mentorId} and upper(p.user_type)='STUDENT' and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' order by u.nick_name,u.user_name

select count(distinct u.user_id) from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' and r.role_key=#{roleKey} and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0'

select (select count(1) from gw_assignment where student_id=#{userId}) + (select count(1) from gw_mobile_application where student_id=#{userId}) + (select count(1) from gw_return_application where student_id=#{userId})

select (select count(1) from gw_user_profile where mentor_id=#{userId}) + (select count(1) from gw_room where mentor_id=#{userId}) + (select count(1) from gw_studio_application where mentor_id=#{userId} and status='PENDING')
select (select count(1) from gw_inspection_task where inspector_id=#{userId}) + (select count(1) from gw_inspection_record where inspector_id=#{userId})
mapper.insert: insert into gw_user_profile(user_id,identity_no,user_type,mentor_id) values(#{userId},#{identityNo},#{userType},#{mentorId}) on duplicate key update identity_no=values(identity_no),user_type=values(user_type),mentor_id=values(mentor_id)

insert into gw_user_profile(user_id,identity_no,user_type,mentor_id) select u.user_id,u.user_name,'STUDENT',#{mentorId} from sys_user u where u.user_id=#{studentId} and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' on duplicate key update user_type='STUDENT',mentor_id=values(mentor_id)
mapper.update: update gw_user_profile set mentor_id=null where user_id=#{studentId} and upper(user_type)='STUDENT'
